# ARCADE INVENTORY (generated by `cardmodel arcade inventory --write docs/ARCADE_INVENTORY.md`; do not edit)

Everything that goes into Cardmodel Arcade and its catalogue (vector_duel), and what the card model contributes to each piece. **made by**: `model` = computed or compiled by the model from cards; `cards` = data or card-language logic the model runs and checks; `hand` = written by hand, only built, packaged or served by the model.

| piece | where | size | made by | what the model contributes | witness |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Vector Duel: the game card | cards/game/vector_duel/card.json | 132 strings, 4 tunes, 6 ladder opponents, 6 arenas, 10 achievements, 3 versions (now 0.3.0) | cards | Holds every number, word, tune and store text as data. gen.py turns it into the integer tables the logic reads; a change to the card is a new build, which the launcher offers as an update. | `tests/test_arcade.py::test_tables_come_from_the_cards` |
| Vector Duel: its logic | cards/game/vector_duel/core.card, cards/game/vector_duel/gfx.card, cards/game/vector_duel/duel.card, cards/game/vector_duel/ai.card, cards/game/vector_duel/draw.card, cards/game/vector_duel/screens.card, cards/game/vector_duel/audio.card, cards/game/vector_duel/save.card | 8 card-language files, 3,299 lines; one module of 193 functions, 68 globals, 132 arrays | cards | The whole game (frame loop, software renderer, duel, AIs, screens, synth, save) is card language: the model's compiler turns it into card IR, the C language card emits it, and the same module runs in the Python emission for the witnesses. | `tests/test_arcade.py::test_module_runs_the_same_in_two_engines` |
| Vector Duel: equilibrium tables | computed at build time (arcade/gen.py) | 27 exact mixes over 24 moves and 3 fighters | model | The equilibrium AI plays mixes the model solves exactly (rational simplex with a checked certificate, game/analysis.py) for every fighter pair and distance. | `tests/test_game.py` |
| The rules: move, fighter, stance and payoff cards | cards/move, cards/fighter, cards/stance, cards/payoff | 24 moves and 3 fighters used by the catalogue (24 move cards, 4 stances); 8 design laws | cards | Every outcome on screen is decided by these cards. The model proves the design laws on them (no dominant option, two answers per attack, ...) on the exact equilibrium of the exchange. | `tests/test_game.py::test_design_laws_hold_and_catch_imbalance` |
| The combat kernel | stdlib/combat.card | 10 functions, 10 theorems, 74 lines | cards | Alignment, timing classes and outcomes as card language: its theorems are witnessed on every verify (and proved where Lean can), and the game calls these functions for every hit. | `tests/test_arcade.py::test_a_timed_guard_redirects` |
| The font | asset/font_5x7 | 63 glyphs | cards | Glyph rows as data; the game draws every letter itself. |  |
| Platform macos: the effect shell | cards/platform/macos/GameShell.swift | 358 lines of Swift; library through the c language card; bundle layout and icon tool as data | hand | Hand-written and deliberately game-blind (CM21, CM35): it moves pixels, samples, buttons and save bytes for whatever module game.json names. The model compiles it from the platform card and lays out the bundle from the card's data. | `tests/test_arcade.py::test_native_package_runs_headless` |
| The launcher (native client) | cards/app/arcade/Launcher.swift | 443 lines of Swift | hand | Hand-written: downloads with every chunk's SHA-256 checked, delta updates, verify and repair, play time, achievements. The model builds it from the app card (compile command, bundle, an icon drawn by code); `arcade check` replays its protocol step for step. | `tests/test_arcade.py::test_every_catalogue_item_launches_from_the_store` |
| The launcher's pages | cards/app/arcade/ui/app.css, cards/app/arcade/ui/app.js, cards/app/arcade/ui/index.html | 3 files, 612 lines | hand | Store, library, downloads, news, profile and settings. Every word and picture they show about a game comes from its card and from pictures the game drew. |  |
| The arcade service | cardmodel/arcade/server.py | 4 API endpoints plus depots, chunks, media and pages | model | Builds a game from its cards on demand when they changed (the hash of its sources), and serves the catalogue, manifests and content-addressed chunks. | `tests/test_arcade.py::test_service_serves_catalog_manifest_and_chunks` |
| The build pipeline and depots | cardmodel/arcade/build.py | 6 steps; chunks of 1 MiB named by SHA-256 | model | Cards -> card IR -> C card -> shared library; the platform card's shell; store pictures drawn by the game itself, headless; a bundle; a depot whose chunks rebuild every file exactly. | `tests/test_arcade.py::test_manifest_chunks_rebuild_the_files` |
| Witnesses | tests/test_arcade.py, laws CM35 and CM39, goal G_S1_store_launches | 11 tests | model | The cycle runs `arcade check` on every run: each catalogue item installed, verified, repaired and played through the store. |  |

Pieces by maker: cards 5, hand 3, model 4.
